generatedProse.practice-connection:
You now have a way of working that will serve you in every piece of writing from here on. Each argument you build from several sources, each judgement you reach and defend, each word you choose for its precise meaning is this capability at work. The habit to keep is simple: set your sources in relation, reach a position you can justify, and choose the words that make the reasoning visible.

That same habit carries into professional life. Wherever you are asked to weigh what is known, take a position and defend it in writing, the people whose work carries weight are the ones who argue with reasons. The moves you have just practised are ones you will use long after you graduate.
